text: The dimension (also called the degree) of a representation $\rho:G\to GL(V)$ is $\dim_k V$.
explanation: True: the dimension, or degree, of $\rho$ is defined to be $\dim_k V$, the dimension of the representation space. Choosing a basis identifies $GL(V)\cong GL_n(k)$ with $n=\dim_k V$, so each $g$ acts by an $n\times n$ invertible matrix.
